package.name: MeshToCAD
package.description: Bring a mesh in (scan, download, or AI-generated) and run the mesh-to-cad pipeline from inside FreeCAD: intake with units check, quality gate, geometry analysis, rebuild guidance, deviation checking, a verification report, and STEP/STL/TechDraw export. Honest about what it can't do — no magic scan-to-CAD button.
